items.title: 20.2.2 Steps of Recombinant DNA Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 157-160).

blocks.text: i: DNA Cleavage (DNA ko kaatna): Jis jandar se gene lena hai us ka source DNA restriction endonuclease se kaata jata hai aur gene of interest alag kar liya jata hai. Isi tarah vector ka DNA (maslan plasmid ya virus ka DNA) bhi usi endonuclease se kaata jata hai. Is tarah gene of interest aur kate hue vector dono par aapas mein milne wale (compatible) sticky ends ban jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam. Qadam 1: janwar ke cell ka DNA (gene of interest ke ird gird recognition sites) aur E. coli ka plasmid (recognition site wala lacZ' gene, antibiotic muzahimat ka gene) aik hi enzyme se kaate jate hain aur sticky ends bante hain. Qadam 2: DNA ligase inhein jor kar recombinant DNA plasmids banata hai jin ka lacZ' gene be-kaar (nonfunctional) hai. Qadam 3: plasmids bacterial cells mein jate hain jo Clone 1, 2 aur 3 banate hain. Qadam 4: clones mein gene of interest dhoonda jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.3: Recombinant vectors banane ke qadam (kitab ki Figure 20.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Animal cell, DNA, Gene of interest, E. coli, Plasmid, lacZ' gene, Recognition site, Antibiotic resistance gene, Sticky ends, Recombinant DNA, Nonfunctional lacZ' gene, Clone 1-3, aur chaar qadam ki ibaratein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 20.3 mein plasmid ke gene ko 'Antibody resistance gene' likha hai. Sahi naam 'antibiotic resistance gene' (antibiotic ke khilaf muzahimat ka gene) hai, jaisa kitab ke apne matan (text) mein bhi hai; is liye upar ke khaake mein sahi naam likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step 1: janwar ke cell ka DNA aur E. coli ka plasmid aik hi restriction endonuclease se kaate jate hain aur sticky ends bante hain. Step 2: DNA ligase in ko jor kar recombinant DNA banata hai; gene of interest lacZ' gene ke beech mein lagne se lacZ' gene nonfunctional (bekaar) ho jata hai. Step 3: recombinant DNA bacteria mein jata hai jo barh kar clones banate hain. Step 4: clones mein gene of interest talaash kiya jata hai. Antibiotic resistance gene ki wajah se sirf plasmid wale bacteria antibiotic wali plate par ugte hain.

ii: Recombinant DNA (vector) ki tayyari: Gene of interest ko kate hue vector mein dala jata hai. Is ke liye kata hua vector aur gene of interest DNA ligase ki maujoodgi mein aik saath incubate kiye jate hain (munasib halaat mein rakhe jate hain). Yeh enzyme phosphodiester linkages bana kar dono ko jor deta hai. Is tarah vector recombinant vector ban jata hai, yaani aisa vector jis mein gene of interest hai.
